body:
Canonicalization can refuse reserved vocabulary or an exhausted search budget.
Public identity and comparison callers currently route some of those refusals
through panic adapters. Remove that parallel API family and propagate the
original native error through carrier/proof digests, graph comparisons and flat
output. GTS public digest and verifier paths share one fallible implementation.

This is a v4 API break. The remaining fallible functions are the single path;
there is no compatibility shim. Successful canonical bytes, graph labels, hash
choice and refusal order stay intact. Search-budget/default changes, UDF frames
and Datalog policies remain in the parent contract.

Selected native acceptance passes 294 cases across canonicalization, views,
dataset-state/CDT identity, RDF profile/W3C fixtures, GTS certification, reasoning,
flat output, SPARQL comparison and the shared justification boundary. One
unrelated existing large-compaction case remains ignored. Strict production
compilation covers all affected host consumers; selected strict checks cover
the 37 changed integration targets and three benchmarks.

The optimized release WASM package build passes, including link, optimization
and SIMD checks. Its single documented JavaScript Error boundary case passes:
the original native refusal crosses as an Error carrying the IRI, without a WASM
trap. General semantics stay in native Rust.

The complete normal commit hook and push pass. Current-head hosted checks and
independent review remain pending.

Closes #704. Parent #489 remains open for its remaining complete requirements.
